name: Streamystats
description: Streamystats is a statistics and analytics service for Jellyfin. It shows watch history, per-user, library and client statistics and watch-time graphs for one or more servers, and can import history from Jellystat and the Playback Reporting plugin.

notes.text: The first visit asks for your Jellyfin URL and an API key (Jellyfin: Dashboard > API Keys). After that, sign in with your Jellyfin account; Jellyfin admins get the admin views.
AI chat and recommendations stay off until you set up a provider under Settings > AI.
